entries.claim: The Christmas source directs this introit to Tempora/Nat30; inherited body and shared doxology have separately declared dependencies.
The inherited Introitus supplies antiphon18, psalm20, &Gloria21 and repeated antiphon22; the shared doxology is a separate declared dependency.
The full Gloria Patri through Amen supplies words w029-w048 after the proper's cue. Declared house punctuation and accents are applied; the Ordo's S./M. performers are not transferred to the introit.

The Benziger 1962 proper prints the 21-word antiphon, seven-word psalm and abbreviated Gloria Patri and repetition cues. The complete 69-word witness explicitly expands the doxology from Ordo p. 219 and repeats the antiphon under RG427; house expansion accidentals are declared.
RG427 prescribes antiphon, psalm, Gloria Patri and repeated antiphon; it supports this Christmas expansion, not a new performance map or complete seasonal-formulary approval.
